Hey guys, im new in this game. What char should I choose?
You should save the item
i would recommend rolling each realm a couple of times until you have a solid base of characters and use it to patch up anything missing before heading into wheel jail
You can use it later when you have a more complete roster and understanding of what you might need
I see.. Anyways what's wheel jail?
When you have most standard characters, you'll want to spend a lot of time pulling wheels (this games' weapons)
So people call it jail
duplicates are very important in this game and you will want to have +12 (that's 16 total copies) of certain wheels (weapons) so you can double equip ssrs
its a very long and slow process (hence jail) but its widely considered to be the best use of your standard pulls once you have a good foundation of characters
